_comment: The only numbers allowed in copy without an estimate label. Every entry carries a non-empty source: a stat with no source is not usable, even if it is true (Byron, Aug 26: use credible, sourced statistics selectively; never force generic marketing data onto private clubs). All benchmark entries are attributed as industry benchmarks, never as a Club Pilot or client outcome, and never fused with each other. Enforced by stat-gate.js.

_bannedTreatmentGlossary.fuse-with-speed: An open-rate figure and a time window in the same sentence. '98% opened within 3 minutes' exists in no source, including Trinity's own line, which is flagged in the open questions.
_bannedTreatmentGlossary.email-comparison: Setting this stat against an email figure. Channel-versus-channel framing was retired 2026-08-26; email is part of the platform.
_bannedTreatmentGlossary.email-failure-implication: Using this stat to imply club emails fail. Club event emails open at 50 to 70%.
